meta.title: Evaluator rejects a re-evaluation request; ranks stay unchanged
gaps: The catalog has no dedicated assertion that the post-rejection ranks exactly match the original ranks.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog has no dedicated assertion that the post-rejection ranks exactly match the original ranks.

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and an evaluation awaiting action.
Navigate to the Technical Stage where the re-evaluation request is shown.

args.goal: as the technical evaluator, open the pending re-evaluation request, choose Reject, enter a rejection reason, click Reject Re-evaluation, and stop when the affected line items show their original rankings and the status TR Submitted

steps.note: Perform the re-evaluation rejection flow and inspect the resulting ranks and status on screen.
Confirm the technical re-evaluation status returned to TR Submitted.
